source: rules/advanced-effect-event-deps.md#Do Not Put Effect Events in Dependency Arrays
rule: Do not include useEffectEvent results in effect dependency arrays

rule: Store event handlers in refs for stable subscriptions

source: rules/advanced-init-once.md#Initialize App Once, Not Per Mount
rule: Run app-wide init once per load, not in useEffect([])
Use useEffectEvent to access latest values without effect re-runs

source: rules/async-api-routes.md#Prevent Waterfall Chains in API Routes
rule: In API routes/Server Actions, start independent promises early and await late
Evaluate a cheap synchronous condition before awaiting a flag/remote value in `flag && cond` checks
gap: Selector `LogicalExpression[operator='&&'] > AwaitExpression.left` flags every `(await x) && y`; cannot tell whether `y` is cheap or has side effects
notes: Selector verified on bad/good snippets only; not shipped in config

rule: Move await into the branch that uses it; do not block branches that do not need the result
Use better-all or early-started promises for partially dependent async work
Use Promise.all() for independent async operations instead of sequential awaits
gap: Independence of two awaits is not syntactically decidable; core no-await-in-loop only covers loops (not in rule text)
notes: No rule fired on the upstream snippet in the differential scan

rule: Use Suspense boundaries instead of awaiting data before returning wrapper JSX
Use literal/explicit-map paths for import() and fs paths so bundlers/tracers can analyze them
gap: Selector covers non-literal import() only; fs/path.join(process.cwd(), var) half not covered
notes: Selector verified on bad/good snippets; not shipped

rule: Import directly from source files, not barrel files (or use optimizePackageImports)
gap: Flags every barrel import including the Next.js-recommended `import {x} from "lucide-react"` + optimizePackageImports (needs allowList); native panic on barrels with unresolvable deps (observed with @mui/material); optimizePackageImports config advice is not lintable
notes: Verified on a local 4-export barrel (maxModuleGraphSizeAllowed:2) and on lucide-react (1892 modules). Shipped as "off" in config

rule: Load large modules/data only when the feature is activated
Load analytics/logging/error-tracking after hydration
gap: Which packages count as non-critical is project-specific (a no-restricted-imports list would be needed)

rule: Use next/dynamic for heavy components not needed on first render
Preload heavy bundles on hover/focus/flag
Share global event listeners across component instances (useSWRSubscription)
gap: Needs cross-component analysis; @eslint-react/web-api-no-leaked-event-listener checks cleanup, not dedup

rule: Version localStorage keys, store minimal fields, wrap access in try/catch
gap: Selector covers only the try/catch half; versioning and minimal-fields not lintable
notes: Selector verified; not shipped

source: rules/client-passive-event-listeners.md#Use Passive Event Listeners for Scrolling Performance
rule: Add { passive: true } to touch/wheel listeners that do not call preventDefault()
gap: Only inline-function listeners are flagged; listeners passed by identifier (the upstream example form) are NOT flagged
notes: Verified: inline wheel/touchstart flagged, passive/preventDefault variants clean, identifier form not flagged

rule: Use SWR (or similar) so identical requests are deduplicated
Avoid interleaving style writes and layout reads
Cache repeated function calls in a module-level Map
Cache property lookups in hot loops
Cache localStorage/sessionStorage/cookie reads
Combine multiple filter/map passes into one loop
gap: No existing rule fired in the scan

rule: Return early when the result is determined
gap: unicorn/prefer-continue fired on the snippet but is unrelated
notes: Judgement

source: rules/js-flatmap-filter.md#Use flatMap to Map and Filter in One Pass
rule: Use flatMap instead of map().filter(Boolean)

notes: Selector verified: map->filter flagged, flatMap and filter->map clean; not shipped

rule: Hoist RegExp creation out of render/loops
gap: Selector `:function NewExpression[callee.name='RegExp']` also flags legitimately dynamic regexes (e.g. built from query)
notes: Selector verified; not shipped

source: rules/js-index-maps.md#Build Index Maps for Repeated Lookups
rule: Build a Map for repeated .find() by key

rule: Defer non-critical work with requestIdleCallback

rule: Use <Activity> for expensive show/hide

rule: Apply content-visibility: auto to long lists

source: rules/rerender-defer-reads.md#Defer State Reads to Usage Point
rule: Do not subscribe to state (searchParams etc.) that is only read in callbacks

rule: Use functional setState when new state depends on current state

rule: Pass an initializer function to useState for expensive initial values

rule: Extract expensive work into memoized components to allow early returns
